sources.snippet: In Pipecat pipelines, we generally run Smart Turn in parallel with transcription. This parallelization gives you the fastest possible end-to-end latency. If you're using Pipecat, you'll get the new 3.2 weights automatically when you upgrade to the next (upcoming) release of Pipecat.
